elements.name: Scorpio
elements.text: Scorpio: intensity and transformation, a comfort with what lies beneath the surface as what no longer has life is shed.

elements.name: Scythe
elements.text: The scythe he carries: the clean, necessary cut, clearing what is no longer viable to make room for new blood.

elements.name: Rising sun
elements.text: A sun rising behind the brush at his feet: the vital, organic process that follows every ending, new life taking root.

rounds.text: Scorpio belongs to November, when decay feeds new growth just as falling leaves fertilize the roots beneath them. Sitting between {b1} and death, Scorpio is magnetic and intense, aware that reaching what's essential means releasing what no longer has life in it. Death carries the same message: not an ending sealed shut, but an organic process that clears space for fresh blood and new {b2}.
